title: Verify: ExecutionPanel Reject button unit tests
summary: Unit tests for Reject visibility and callback, and unchanged Approve/Retry
description: Add a new test file rendering ExecutionPanel directly with vi.fn callbacks, asserting Reject gating and that Approve and Retry still work.
acceptance_criteria: Reject shows only for AWAITING_APPROVAL with onReject and calls onReject with the id
Reject is hidden without onReject and for other statuses
Approve and Retry still call their callbacks with the id
definition_of_done: All tests in the new file pass

steps.action: Create the file with imports from @testing-library/react, userEvent, vitest, ExecutionPanel and executionFixture from ./fixtures/api (the ExecutionInfo contract); add renderPanel(status, withReject = true) rendering ExecutionPanel with execution {...executionFixture, id: 'EX1', status}, contributionCount 2 and vi.fn onApprove, onRetry and optional onReject, plus afterEach(cleanup).
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/executionReject.test.tsx
steps.expected: Helper renders the panel and returns the mocks; the file is collected by vitest without import errors

steps.symbol: it: shows Reject for AWAITING_APPROVAL and calls onReject with the id
steps.action: Render with status AWAITING_APPROVAL, click the button named Reject, assert onReject called once with 'EX1' and onApprove/onRetry not called.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/executionReject.test.tsx -t "shows Reject for AWAITING_APPROVAL"

steps.symbol: it: hides Reject without onReject or for non-awaiting statuses
steps.action: Render AWAITING_APPROVAL without onReject, then FAILED and RUNNING with onReject; assert queryByRole('button', {name:'Reject'}) is not in the document each time.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/executionReject.test.tsx -t "hides Reject"

steps.symbol: it: Approve and Retry still call their callbacks
steps.action: Render AWAITING_APPROVAL, click Approve, assert onApprove called with 'EX1'; render FAILED, click Retry, assert onRetry called with 'EX1'; assert onReject never called.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/executionReject.test.tsx
